content:
maria: FYI started onboarding paperwing-2 embeddings (float->int6 conversion experiment). Quick holdout run on short-queries (3.2k) shows a sharp top1 degradation.

derek: numbers? batch/seq? index-norm?

maria: batch=1, seq<=12, no index-time norm. float32 recall@1=0.912 -> int6 (per-tensor) 0.774; int6 (per-channel) 0.801. recall@5 also drops but less.

elena: huge. breakdown by query length/freq? any language skew?

maria: short noun phrases (len<=4) lose most. freq=low bucket loses ~22 points; high freq unaffected. english/spanish both show drop but spanish smaller.

noah: did you inspect norm histogram and nearest-neighbor rank flips?

maria: yes: mean L2 norm float32=1.10 -> int6=0.70. cosine tail moves closer to 0.0; many rank-1 hits flip to rank 3-6. Per-query diff shows stopword-only queries get randomized.

elena: possible mitigations: 1) simple post-hoc L2-normalize index vectors 2) per-channel scaling with percentile clipping 3) try nf4/8bit-fp fallback 4) augment index with additional precomputed hashed tokens to stabilize short queries.

derek: run quick proofs: a) index L2-normalize -> measure recall & write latency b) per-channel+99.9th clip -> measure recall c) nf4 quant run on same harness.

ops-bot: pausing paperwing-2 int6 rollout in staging as requested by eng-ml (reason: top1 regressions on short-queries).

maria: ran index L2-normalize on stored vectors: recall@1 improves to 0.902 (almost baseline). write latency +1.1ms median. per-channel+clip gives ~0.815. nf4 run pending.

elena: good sign that angle-preserving normalization helps. tradeoff: need to decide if we normalize at index time (cheap at write) vs add normalization on the online embed path (adds infer cost).

derek: also flag to data team: we should add more short-query templates to holdout. current suite underrepresents them.

maria: opening PR with harness, per-query diffs, and the index-normalize patch. Will attach raw output and command to reproduce. cc @derek @elena @noah

--- quick table ---
```
-- short-queries (3.2k)
float32: recall@1=0.912 recall@5=0.975 mean_L2=1.10
int6 (per-tensor): recall@1=0.774 recall@5=0.945 mean_L2=0.70
int6 (per-channel): recall@1=0.801 recall@5=0.956 mean_L2=0.88
int6 + index-l2norm: recall@1=0.902 recall@5=0.973 mean_L2=1.00
```

noah: great. once PR is up I can schedule nf4 perf run and a lang parity check.

elena: also add a small eval that tracks NN label flips and stopword-heavy queries specifically.

maria: will include both. ops-bot: mark incident if any customer sees degradation.

ops-bot: reminder logged: monitor customer-facing endpoints for regressions.

maria: thanks all, will post PR link and results.
